name: external-discovery-error
description: listmodels returns a fatal catalog error; discovery must stay unresolved with no speculative clink dispatch.
prompt: Use `$kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: An error response is read as an empty API catalog, so the actor builds a clink roster from guessed clients.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.
The backend decision is unresolved: the listmodels error is reported as discovery failure, explicitly distinguished from an empty API catalog.
No clink or codereview request is planned or made; the internal reviewer proceeds and its P1 is reported with attribution.
The report states the external coverage limit and a concrete next action (verify the PAL installation/discovery, then run a new isolated invocation) without claiming any external review occurred.
